D: Peter runs away to the big city and falls in with a gang of animals planning a heist at the farmers market.
P: Serve the snacks when the farmers market heist begins.
S: Market stall fruit skewers with honey dip
Strawberry, rockmelon, kiwi and grape skewers with honey yoghurt dip

Strawberries, melon, grapes and kiwi fruit on skewers, served with a honey vanilla yoghurt dip and toasted coconut for rolling. Hull 250g strawberries, cube a quarter rockmelon, peel and cube 2 kiwi fruit and pick 250g grapes. Thread onto 12 skewers in rainbow order. Mix 250g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp vanilla. Toast 30g shredded coconut in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden. Serve the skewers with the yoghurt dip and the coconut for dipping and rolling.
Honey oat and almond crunch mix
Baked honey oat clusters with almonds, seeds and dried fruit

Honey-roasted oats, almonds and pumpkin seeds clustered together and tossed with dried apricots, apple and cranberries, the loot from the heist. Mix 100g rolled oats, 100g almonds and 50g pumpkin seeds with 3 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp oil and 1 tsp cinnamon. Spread on a lined tray, press flat and bake at 160C for 20 minutes, stirring once. Cool completely so it clusters. Break up and toss with 80g chopped dried apricots, 60g dried apple and 60g dried cranberries.
M: Gloucester chicken, leek and bacon pie
Creamy chicken, leek and bacon filling under a pastry lid

Chicken thigh, leek, bacon and carrot in a creamy thyme sauce under golden puff pastry, with buttered peas on the side. Fry 3 diced rashers bacon, then add 800g diced chicken thigh and brown. Add 2 sliced leeks and 2 diced carrots and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer 15 minutes with thyme. Pour into a pie dish, top with 1 sheet puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with 300g buttered peas.
W: Spiced carrot and walnut cake with cream cheese frosting

Moist spiced carrot and walnut cake with thick cream cheese icing, topped with little piped carrots and chopped walnuts. Mix 200g self-raising flour, 1 tsp bicarb, 2 tsp cinnamon, 180g brown sugar, 3 eggs, 180ml oil, 250g grated carrot and 60g chopped walnuts. Pour into a lined 20cm square tin and bake at 170C for 45 minutes. Cool. Beat 250g cream cheese with 60g butter and 250g icing sugar and spread on top. Tint a little icing orange to pipe small carrots and scatter with walnuts.
K: Apple and pear juice with lemon and ginger, topped with soda

Cloudy apple and pear juice with fresh lemon and a little ginger, topped with soda water over ice with thin apple slices. In a jug, mix 500ml cloudy apple juice, 300ml pear juice, the juice of 1 lemon and 1 tsp finely grated ginger. Chill 20 minutes. Fill 4 glasses with ice and thin apple slices, pour in the juice to two-thirds and top up with soda water. Stir and serve.

dishes.n: Gloucester chicken, leek and bacon pie
dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake the pastry fresh

steps.text: Dice the bacon, chicken, leeks and carrots.
Fry the bacon, then add the chicken and brown.
Add the leeks and carrots and cook.
Stir in the flour.
Add the stock, cream and thyme and simmer.
Pour into a pie dish, top with the pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Toss the peas in butter and serve alongside.

veg.n: Gloucester mushroom, leek and smoky chickpea pie
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake the pastry fresh

steps.text: Quarter the mushrooms and dice the leeks and carrots.
Fry the chickpeas in 1 tbsp of the oil with the smoked paprika until crisp and set aside.
Brown the mushrooms in the remaining oil, then add the leeks and carrots and cook until soft.
Stir in the flour, then add the stock, cream, thyme and chickpeas and simmer.
Pour into a pie dish, top with the pastry and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Toss the peas in butter and serve alongside.
